title: Creamy Chicken Tortellini Soup
description: Using canned cream of chicken as a base, you can have a quick and simple pot of tortellini soup by adding the pasta, more cooked chicken, and spinach.
ingredients: 0.5 pound chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces
2 (10.5 ounce) cans cream of chicken soup
1 (10 ounce) package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained

steps.text: Bring a saucepan of water to a boil. Cook chicken in boiling water until no longer pink in the center, 7 to 10 minutes; drain.

Bring chicken broth to a boil in a soup pot; add cheese tortellini, reduce heat to medium-low, and cook until tortellini are cooked through and firm to the bite, about 8 minutes. Stir chicken, cream of chicken soup, half-and-half, spinach, thyme, and black pepper with the tortellini; bring to a simmer and continue cooking until hot, 7 to 10 minutes. Serve hot.
